settings.title: Settings
settings.helpEveryone: Anyone signed in can see your display name, about text and sports. Your email address is never shown.
settings.helpPeers: Default. Only people you shared an event with, and organizers weighing your request, can see it.
settings.marketing: I'd like to receive news and tips
settings.marketingHelp: You can turn this off at any time. Using the app does not depend on it.
settings.reliabilityHelp: Even when off, organizers see it while weighing your request.
settings.analyticsConsent: I give my explicit consent for which parts of the app I use (for example opening the map, choosing a filter, the result of "Near me") to be recorded linked to my account and reviewed to improve the app.
settings.analyticsHelp: Your location, messages and anything you write are never recorded, and the records hold nothing about other people. Consenting is not a condition for using the app. You can withdraw at any time; withdrawing deletes what was recorded until then. The records appear in your data export.
settings.analyticsOff: Consent withdrawn; the records were deleted.
